CINE 100.title: Introduction to Cinema Studies
CINE 100.description: Basic aesthetic, economic, sociological, and technological aspects of film.

CINE 200.title: Introduction to Canadian Cinema
CINE 200.description: History and aesthetics of Canadian cinema.

CINE 210.title: Early Cinema
CINE 210.description: Aesthetics, economics, history, and technological characteristics of international early film.

CINE 220.title: Hollywood Cinema 1930-1960
CINE 220.description: Analysis of the aesthetics, economics, history and technological characteristics of the Classical Hollywood period.

CINE 230.title: Introduction to Asian Cinema
CINE 230.description: Overview of the cinemas of China, India, Japan, and Korea.

CINE 240.title: Media Industries
CINE 240.description: Overview of today's film and media industries, and of the concepts governing their practices.

CINE 331.title: Studies in Film Theory
CINE 331.description: A seminar introducing the many theoretical approaches to film: formalist, historical, Marxist, psychoanalytic, semiotic, and structuralist.

CINE 332.title: Studies in Genre or Period
CINE 332.description: A seminar examining one or more genres or periods, such as the Western, Film Noir, Science Fiction, Films of the 1980's. Also includes study of national cinemas.

CINE 334.title: Seminar in Documentary
CINE 334.description: An analysis of the representational strategies and ethics of the form.

CINE 336.title: Seminar in European Cinema
CINE 336.description: Topics may include a study of a European national cinema.

CINE 338.title: Asian and Australasian Cinema
CINE 338.description: Topics may include an analysis of a national cinema, such as that of China, India, or Australia.

CINE 340.title: Media Audiences
CINE 340.description: Overview of approaches for studying audiences and receptions of film and contemporary media.

CINE 430.title: Studies in Auteurism
CINE 430.description: A seminar examining the work of one or more directors, such as John Ford, Francois Truffaut, Denys Arcand, Margarethe Von Trotta, or of a screenwriter over many films.

CINE 432.title: Seminar in Motion Picture Forms
CINE 432.description: Animation, experimental, and/or multimedia. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 432 or CINE_V 432.

CINE 434.title: Studies in Film
CINE 434.description: A seminar devoted to a topic of current interest in film. Topic will change from year to year. May be repeated for credit when topics differ. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 434 or CINE_V 434.

CINE 436.title: Seminar in American Cinema Since 1960
CINE 436.description: Topics may include an analysis of a specific period.

CINE 438.title: Seminar in Canadian Cinema
CINE 438.description: Topics may include an analysis of the Canadian Governmental agencies supporting Film Production. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 438 or CINE_V 438.

CINE 449.title: Honours Essay
CINE 449.description: A course allowing honours students to work with a faculty member on a major research paper.
